newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to auction 0.45 pct of NORSI Oil.
newsitem.headline: Russia to auction 0.45 pct of NORSI Oil.

text.p: Russia's federal property fund will auction a 0.45 percent stake of 2.69 million shares in independent oil company NK NORSI Oil on November 13, the fund said in a schedule of forthcoming auctions released on Monday.
Norsi owns the refinery in Nizhny Novgorod and four marketing facilities in the city, but does not have its own production or exploration units.
The government is due to sell a 34 percent stake in NORSI this year.
Last month the government said it had approved a plan by NK LUKoil, Russia's biggest oil group, Alfa-Bank and other investors to form a financial-industrial group with NORSI to modernise is refinery.
